# Coverage & On-Call

`customer_support.entitlement_and_sla.coverage_and_on_call` · v0.1.0 · **draft** · **STUB**

**Is someone who can actually help awake, reachable and accountable right now?**


> Making sure somebody who can actually help is awake, reachable and accountable for every hour a promise is live. Coverage is the arithmetic that turns a contractual window into a roster, and all of the expertise is in the seams rather than the middle of a shift: the handover between regions, the public holiday that exists in one country and not the next, the on-call engineer who is nominally covering a product area they have never worked on. A coverage gap almost never presents as a gap — it presents hours later and somewhere else, as a breach, an unacknowledged incident, or a customer who called the number on the contract and got nobody.
